source: Original statically authored pixel SVG masters by Copilot for this project; no external services, reference images, or third-party artwork.
rights: Original project artwork; no external attribution or license dependencies.
approval: Inspected all 16 materials in native 1024x768 GL Compatibility contact sheets and 600x220 hero triptychs. Revised flame grounding, meniscus silhouette, fizz size and curd containment from actual first-pass captures.
refinement: Native focused ExperimentHero inspection: three asymmetrical overlapping flame lobes with independent local-time curl; irregular char/ember edge; nine bounded drifting smoke billows; local warm glass reflection; 16 transparent bubbles with size-varying rise and surface rupture; scalloped foam; low-opacity glass walls and a broken double specular rim. Silver tarnish metadata now identifies time-lapse. No audio or scientific sets changed.
art_direction: Brass-lit laboratory glass, violet shadow planes, parchment highlights, stepped pixel clusters. Distinct material palettes describe appearance, not scientific classification.
normalization: Godot Image.load_svg_from_string at 1x, RGBA8 PNG; normalize_assets.gd. Runtime loads PNG only, nearest filtering, no mipmaps.

naturalness_stage.glass: Neutral transparent pane art replaces ice-like blue glass. Seven complementary source-pixel regions retain their area, fall together before impact at 0.60s, then use cached 240Hz gravity/contact/friction integration. Restitution 0.18, convex-hull tray support and sleep replace repeated triangle sprites and sine bounces.
naturalness_stage.ice: A 257-state asymmetric inward erosion mask retains texture detail and grounds the surviving bottom. Similar-section volume estimate and reference densities 917/1000 conserve model mass; the final normalized water volume is 0.917.
naturalness_stage.other_materials: Wax slumps without cyclic wobble; original cloth pixels separate progressively; nails accelerate and stop at contact; crystals and curds form at irregular stationary sites. Bubbles originate after emission onset and follow the changing liquid level. Visible boiling mist represents condensed droplets.
naturalness_stage.generated_data: normalize_assets.gd creates physical_masks.png and physical_geometry.json plus an exportable physical_geometry.gd constant resource. The PNG mask is data, not replacement illustration; source SVG/PNG specimens remain the visual artwork.
naturalness_stage.validation: 302 renderer checks; 14788 model checks; all16 native reset/replay pixel comparisons match; native 1024x768 motion strips and real-room EN/ZH captures inspected.
naturalness_stage.limits: Simplified educational model: gravity is in presentation units, volume is inferred from the raster section, heat transfer and fluid flow are not solved, and thin-shard tilt is a projected presentation model without inter-fragment collision. No claim of perfect physical simulation, calibrated reaction rates or experimental prediction.
